mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances, or RSAFS growth does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO MoM growth < 0% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r > -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates robust demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson r < 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the tight monetary policy combined with a tight labor market leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson r < 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r > -0.1).
